input: Two identical fresh copies of each preserved public D-final patch; original task and same ordinary project check results. No grader or reference fixes.
rubric: Correct requested behavior through public entry points
Required regression delivered and actually executed
Independent stateful scenarios initialized correctly, including disconnected reconnect
Legacy runtime acceptance and repeat preparation/fresh loading delivered
Other ownership, permissions, rejection and preservation requirements retained
Full patch acceptable only when all applicable obligations and checks supported
claimBoundary: Selected known failures, not an independent lift benchmark. Extra H compute recorded. No retries or rubric changes. Historical artifacts immutable.
stop: Quota, authorization refusal or uncertain provider/process completion stops scheduling. No alternate access.
